question: Kailangan pa ba ng bagong fire inspection para sa business permit kung may valid FSIC na galing sa Occupancy Permit?
answer:
Wala kaayong kailangan bag-ong fire inspection para sa business permit kung may valid FSIC na galing sa Occupancy Permit. [S3]

For a new business permit with a valid FSIC issued during the Occupancy Permit stage, no new fire inspection is required. [S3]

ground_truth: For new business permits where a valid FSIC was already issued during the Occupancy Permit stage, the applicant presents the certified true copy of the valid occupancy FSIC, paying the 15% FSIF assessment without requiring a separate pre-operational inspection.
